genesis.1.p1.b1.text: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.

genesis.1.p1.b2.text: Now the earth was formless and void, and darkness was over the surface of the deep. And the Spirit of God was hovering over the surface of the waters.

genesis.1.p2.b5.text: And God saw that the light was good, and He separated the light from the darkness.

genesis.1.p2.b6.text: And there was evening, and there was morning—the first day.

genesis.1.p3.b7.text: Let there be an expanse between the waters, to separate the waters from the waters.

genesis.1.p3.b8.text: So God made the expanse and separated the waters beneath it from the waters above.

genesis.1.p3.b9.text: And there was evening, and there was morning—the second day.

genesis.1.p4.b10.text: Let the waters under the sky be gathered into one place, so that the dry land may appear.

genesis.1.p4.b11.text: God called the dry land “earth,” and the gathering of waters He called “seas.”

genesis.1.p4.b12.text: The earth produced vegetation: seed-bearing plants … and trees bearing fruit … And God saw that it was good.

genesis.1.p4.b13.text: And there was evening, and there was morning—the third day.

genesis.1.p5.b14.text: Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to distinguish between the day and the night, and let them be signs to mark the seasons and days and years …

genesis.1.p5.b15.text: God made two great lights: the greater light to rule the day and the lesser light to rule the night. And He made the stars as well.

genesis.1.p5.b16.text: to preside over the day and the night, and to separate the light from the darkness. And God saw that it was good.

genesis.1.p5.b17.text: And there was evening, and there was morning—the fourth day.

genesis.1.p6.b18.text: Let the waters teem with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.

genesis.1.p6.b19.text: So God created the great sea creatures and every living thing that moves, with which the waters teemed according to their kinds, and every bird of flight …

genesis.1.p6.b20.text: Be fruitful and multiply and fill the waters of the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.

genesis.1.p6.b21.text: And there was evening, and there was morning—the fifth day.

genesis.1.p7.b22.text: Let the earth bring forth living creatures according to their kinds: livestock, land crawlers, and beasts of the earth according to their kinds.

genesis.1.p7.b23.text: God made the beasts of the earth according to their kinds, the livestock according to their kinds, and everything that crawls upon the earth according to its kind.

genesis.1.p7.b24.text: And God saw that it was good.

genesis.1.p8.b25.text: Let Us make man in Our image, after Our likeness …

genesis.1.p8.b26.text: So God created man in His own image; in the image of God He created him; male and female He created them.

genesis.1.p8.b27.text: Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the earth and subdue it …

genesis.1.p9.b28.text: Behold, I have given you every seed-bearing plant on the face of all the earth, and every tree whose fruit contains seed. They will be yours for food.

genesis.1.p9.b29.text: And God looked upon all that He had made, and indeed, it was very good.

genesis.1.p9.b30.text: And there was evening, and there was morning—the sixth day.
